review.basis: Developer-authored synthetic regression fixture; clinical review has not been attested. All notes, identifiers, and labels are synthetic; each label element carries a developer rationale string. The token __NOTE_DIGEST__ inside a proposal is replaced by the scoring harness with the sha256 of the case note before validation; wrong-note cases never use the token.

owner_acceptance.basis: The owner accepted these unchanged developer-authored synthetic regression cases and removed the clinician-approval prerequisite. This acceptance is not independent clinical validation.
